production_changes.journey_build: Only the lower Sweet Home 3D model preview; no 2D plan or application controls.
production_changes.sky: One continuous 25-second Cosmic Cliffs take: native transition-room flight, entry, ascending orbit, then fixed-height downward orbit.
production_changes.background: Owner-supplied Jesus, Joy of Man’s Desiring opening picture only, blurred and faded.
production_changes.editorial_typography: No small text, brand headers, URLs, running captions, or footers. Large project questions, concise prompts, and essential rule labels only.
production_changes.bible: Live homepage selection, then Sequence/Rebuild and Next Word, captured at a complete natural viewport and played at approximately 2× speed. Body 24 seconds; chapter 31.2 seconds.
production_changes.cube: Can We Build an 11×11 Cube? Full actual web viewport and unfinished concept sketch retained.
production_changes.roller: Actual native ice-blue spaceGlass funnel and white/ice black hole in entry, overhead spiral and ride shots.
production_changes.titles: Exactly two fixed left-text/right-picture layouts: title and concept; after the title disappears, process prompt and process illustration/video. Then demo. No centered build layout or bottom step chain.
production_changes.chess: The film begins directly with Balanced Chess: What Can Curiosity Build? No separate opening title or duplicate title switch.
production_changes.gallery_concepts: New architectural gallery concept sketches, half line art and half colored, replace both procedural placeholders.

transitions.timing: Centered dissolves with short cloned edge handles preserve every original frame and the exact subtitle clock.
